items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, his brother lives... Where is he? Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, his brother can tell exactly where he's at.

ctx.x: Yeah, his brother lives... Where is he? Yeah. His brother lives here? Yeah.
